install:
command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 || curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
sudo ln -sfn "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" /usr/local/bin/bun
sudo ln -sfn "$HOME/.bun/bin/bunx" /usr/local/bin/bunx
command -v rg >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo apt-get update
command -v rg >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ripgrep
bun install --frozen-lockfile
bunx playwright install chromium
